tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, secondary buttons, input fields.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Quiet fills: neutral badge, option number tiles, the alt primary button.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairline around cards, controls and the empty state (1px).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body copy and headings on bg, surface and surface-2 (16.27:1 light, 14.94:1 dark on surface).

tokens.name: text-2
tokens.usage: Card subtitles and strong secondary copy on surface (10.87:1 light, 11.43:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Captions, meta lines, inactive segments on surface and bg (5.86:1 light, 6.94:1 dark on surface; 5.31:1 light, 7.79:1 dark on bg).

tokens.name: text-badge
tokens.usage: Neutral badge text on surface-2 (7.46:1 light, 10.49:1 dark).

tokens.name: text-tab
tokens.usage: Inactive bottom-tab labels on tabs-bg (5.18:1 light, 6.94:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand
tokens.usage: Links, active tab icon, brand text on surface (5.48:1 light, 8.68:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-strong
tokens.usage: Text on brand-soft: soft buttons, brand badges, option numbers (7.29:1 light, 9.05:1 dark).

tokens.name: brand-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted fill for soft buttons, hovered rows, active rail item, brand badge.

tokens.name: brand-grad-from
tokens.usage: Start of the primary action gradient (135deg).

tokens.name: brand-grad-to
tokens.usage: End of the primary action gradient.

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Label on the primary gradient (worst point under the label 4.59:1 light; 6.57:1 dark).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Gold: the app icon, store art and achievement marks. A fill or a mark, never body text.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold as text (best-score numbers, small gold labels) on surface (4.85:1 light, 11.16:1 dark).

tokens.name: header
tokens.usage: Top bar and the band behind the status bar.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring: 3px solid, offset 2px, on a 2px focus-halo (3.77:1 light, 8.68:1 dark against the halo; non-text, 3:1 needed). Inside dark surfaces of the light theme (header, hero, flashcard back) use emerald-200 on an emerald-950 halo (11.81:1). App v3.4.1 draws exactly this.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: The 2px band between a focused element and its ring, so the ring reads on light, dark and coloured surfaces alike.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Correct / done text on success-bg (6.49:1 light, 10.45:1 dark). Always paired with a check icon or the word.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Wrong / failed text on error-bg (5.98:1 light, 8.53:1 dark). Always paired with an x icon or the word.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Wrong-answer fill, error empty state icon tile.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Memorise / repeat badge text on warning-bg (6.37:1 light, 10.42:1 dark).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info box text on info-bg (5.25:1 light, 10.32:1 dark).

tokens.name: toast-fg
tokens.usage: Toast text on toast-bg (14.0:1 light, 9.52:1 dark) and on toast-bad-bg (9.9:1).

tokens.name: toast-bad-bg
tokens.usage: Toast fill for a failed action.

tokens.name: tabs-bg
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar, blurred over content.

tokens.name: emerald-900
tokens.usage: Deep ink for headings on light grounds.

tokens.name: gold-300
tokens.usage: Gold on deep emerald (titles in store art).

tokens.name: gold-500
tokens.usage: Icon gold (mid stop of the icon’s gold gradient).

tokens.name: gold-800
tokens.usage: Gold dark enough for text on white (4.85:1).

tokens.name: ivory
tokens.usage: Title colour on deep emerald in store art and the reel.
